description_en: Resets a cloud phone instance. The reset process reinstalls the system by using the image of the cloud phone. For example, if the image used to create the cloud phone is deleted, the reset fails
description_zh: 重置云手机实例。 重置是使用该云手机的镜像进行重装系统的过程，例如云手机创建时使用的镜像被删除将重置失败

name: ResetAndroidInstancesInGroup

parameters.help_zh: 售卖模式。该参数已废弃！
parameters.name: sale_mode

parameters.help_en:
<props="china">Specifies whether to retain property settings during the reset. If this parameter is not specified, property configurations are not retained by default. This parameter takes effect only for cloud phone matrix instances. You can run the wya dump config command to view the details of the retained properties.</props>
<props="intl">This parameter is not supported on the international site.</props>
parameters.help_zh:
<props="china">重置是否保留属性设置，不传则默认不保留属性配置，该参数仅针对云手机矩阵实例生效。可执行wya dump config命令查看保留的属性详情。</props>
<props="intl">国际站不支持此参数</props>
parameters.name: setting_reset_type

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to skip parameter validation. A value of true indicates that parameter validation is skipped. A value of false or no value indicates that parameter validation is performed
parameters.help_zh: 是否跳过参数校验；true 表示跳过，false 或不传时执行校验
parameters.name: ignore_param_validation

parameters.help_en: For instances in a cloud phone matrix, specify this parameter if you need to reduce the storage capacity during the reset. This feature is currently available only to whitelisted users
parameters.help_zh: 仅针对云手机矩阵下的实例，重置的同时需要进行存储缩容时，请填写该参数，目前该功能白名单开放
parameters.name: target_data_disk_size

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable automatic payment. Default value: false
parameters.name: auto_pay

OrderId.description_en: For instances in a cloud phone matrix, if storage capacity reduction is performed during the reset, the order ID for the storage capacity reduction is returned. This parameter is not returned in other scenarios
OrderId.description_zh: 针对云手机矩阵下的实例，重置的同时需要进行存储缩容时，会返回存储缩容的订单Id，其他场景不会返回
OrderId.title_en: 针对云手机矩阵下的实例，重置的同时需要进行存储缩容时，会返回存储缩容的订单Id，其他场景不会返回。
OrderId.title_zh: 针对云手机矩阵下的实例，重置的同时需要进行存储缩容时，会返回存储缩容的订单Id，其他场景不会返回。
